## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Sayings-Record of Chán Master Cáoyuán Dàoshēng* — a one-juan Southern-Sòng *yǔlù* of **Cáoyuán Dàoshēng** 曹源道生. Compiled by attendant (*shìzhě* 侍者) [Dàochōng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E5%86%B2) 道冲.

X70 n1375. Note: this Dàochōng is likely distinct from the Míng-Qīng transitional 道沖 who edited [KR6q0206](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0206) *Jī lèi jí*; the name-variant 冲/沖 and the lifetime-spread (Southern Sòng vs. Qīng) distinguish them.
